chat.title: Chat with your notes
chat.body: Ask a question, the answer cites its sources - clickable, filterable by theme.

sync.title: iPhone ↔ Mac, no cloud
sync.body: Direct sync over your Wi-Fi, end-to-end encrypted. No one in the middle, ever.

offline.title: Offline, for real
offline.body: Local transcription with Whisper, from tiny to large-v3-turbo. Airplane mode included, audio never leaves your device.

keyboard.title: Keyboard-first on Mac
keyboard.body: Instant navigation, all from the keyboard.

reminders.title: Say it, it's on your calendar
reminders.body: "Call the bank tomorrow at 10" becomes a reminder, confirmed with one tap on iPhone.

models.title: Your AI, your rules
models.body: Claude or OpenAI with your key, or your ChatGPT subscription. You pick the model.
